Shri Jayesh Yadav - Ga for the State.

Heard on Ia No.12457/2025, which is first application s
 suspension of sentence on behalf of the appellant-

Deepak Bha
 been convicted under sections 366, 376 (2)(f) of the Ipc and 
 of the Pocso Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 5 years Ri & 
 and 10 years Ri with fine of Rs.2,000/- vide judgment dated 1
 Special case No.39/2021 by the learned Special Judge, Pocso A
 Badnagar, District-Ujjain (M.P.).
In this case, the appellant/accused is 19 years old and  years and 10 months old and both belongs to scheduled tribe c
Appellant/accused has undergone more than 5 years and 6 month
. Appellant is every hope of success in this app  hearing of this appeal will likely to take long time.
Hence p  suspension of jail sentence of the appellant and grant him ba
Counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the applic

Considering the custody period of appellant/accused and the fact that conclusion of appeal will take longer time, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence passed against the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail upon his 2 CRA-2621-2023 furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 01.04.2026 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this appeal.
